question.prompt: After representing \(x\ge-2\) on a number line, how many of the integer points \(-4, -3, -2, -1, 0, 1, 2\) lie in the solution set?

solutions.explanation: The solution set consists of \(-2\) and all numbers to its right. The integer points among those listed that lie in this set are \(-2, -1, 0, 1, 2\), for a total of 5.
solutions.title: Count the listed solution points
